title: Vending machine: the last can
summary: Two buyers press the button for the same last can at the same moment.
background: A fleet of connected vending machines reports every sale to a central Postgres. When a buyer presses a button the machine asks the server: is there stock in slot A1? If yes, decrement the stock, record the sale and drop the can.

The naive code reads the stock into the application, checks it, waits a few milliseconds for the payment terminal, then writes stock = value_read - 1. Under READ COMMITTED every transaction sees the last committed value, so two buyers can both read stock = 1, both pass the check and both write stock = 0. Two cans are sold, one exists. This is the lost update anomaly.

The fix is to let the database do the check and the write in one atomic statement: UPDATE slots SET stock = stock - 1 WHERE id = 1 AND stock > 0. The row lock taken by the UPDATE serializes buyers on that row, and the WHERE clause is re-evaluated against the newest version after the lock is granted, so only as many buyers as there are cans succeed. SELECT ... FOR UPDATE before the check works too.

race.goal: Slot 1 is loaded with 10 cans. 20 buyers press buy 3 times each. Exactly 10 sales may happen and the stock must end at 0.

inner.title: Revenue per product
inner.prompt: Join sales, slots and products and sum the revenue of every product that sold at least once.

left.title: Units sold per product, including zero
left.prompt: List every product with how many units it sold. Products that never sold must show 0.

right.title: Machines per location
right.prompt: Show every location with its machines. Locations without machines must appear with NULL.

full.title: Machines and locations mismatch
full.prompt: Find machines not placed in any location and locations with no machine in a single result.

cross.title: Planogram matrix
cross.prompt: Build every machine x product combination and flag which ones are actually stocked in a slot.

self.title: Technician and supervisor
self.prompt: List every technician next to the name of the supervisor they report to.

semi.title: Machines with a sold out slot
semi.prompt: Return the machines that have at least one slot with zero stock, each machine once.

anti.title: Products that never sold
anti.prompt: Return the products that do not appear in any sale.

lateral.title: Last two sales per machine
lateral.prompt: For every machine return its two most recent sales.
